TAN 2|, 2026

ORDINANCE

BEIT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION |: That the Chicago Zoning Ordinance be amended by changing all B3-1
Community Shopping District symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 1-J in the

area bounded by

the alley next north of and parallel to West Franklin Boulevard;
North Kedzie Avenue; West Franklin Boulevard; and North
Sawyer Avenue;

to those of the C1-2 Neighborhood Commercial District and a corresponding use district

is hereby established in the area above described.

SECTION 2: This Ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and

due publication.

3200-24 W. Franklin Blvd.; 501-11 N. Sawyer Ave.; 500-10 N. Kedzie Ave.
